name: 14715 · Bolivar, NY
findings: ZIP 14715 (Bolivar) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14715 (Bolivar) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
